summary.en: Hezbollah suspects were arrested while transporting explosives near the Lebanon-Syria border, and Israeli forces carried out drone and air strikes that wounded six people and killed a Syrian operative accused of planning attacks from the same frontier. Israeli artillery and air attacks continue to target southern Lebanon, killing civilians during olive harvest activities and injuring others. The Lebanese health ministry reports thousands of deaths and injuries since the conflict began in March. The conflict, which started in October 2023, remains focused on border confrontations between Israeli forces and Hezbollah or Iranian-backed actors. 4,335 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Hezbollah-mistenkte ble arrestert mens de transporterte sprengstoff nær grensen mellom Libanon og Syria, og israelske styrker gjennomførte drone- og luftangrep som såret seks personer og drepte en syrisk operativ anklaget for å planlegge angrep fra samme grenseområde. Israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter å treffe sørlige Libanon, og dreper sivile under olivenhøstaktiviteter og skader andre. Det libanesiske helsedepartementet rapporterer tusenvis av dødsfall og skader siden konflikten startet i mars. Konflikten, som begynte i oktober 2023, er fortsatt fokusert på grensekonfrontasjoner mellom israelske styrker og Hezbollah eller iransk-støttede aktører. 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
